Real people. Real service. Real peace of mind. 
Since 1999, Above N' Beyond Office Cleaning has proudly provided professional cleaning services to offices, office buildings, daycare centers, and medical and dental practices throughout Nassau and Suffolk Counties.

Whether he's answering phone calls, texts, and emails, conducting complimentary walkthrough inspections for new cleaning proposals, or performing quality control spot checks, Michael ensures every client receives the personalized attention they deserve. 
We understand that every facility has unique needs. That's why we develop customized cleaning specifications for each account and personally verify that our cleaning teams consistently meet those standards. Why Long Island offices stay with Above N' Beyond 
At Above N' Beyond Office Cleaning, we believe exceptional cleaning starts with responsive communication, dependable service, and people who genuinely care about your business. 
We're small enough to provide personalized attention and big enough to handle your commercial cleaning needs across 67 Long Island towns. 
If you've ever dealt with a cleaning company that stopped returning calls, missed scheduled cleanings, or constantly rotated unfamiliar staff through your facility, you understand the value of consistency and accountability. 
That's why we prioritize reliable service, clear communication, and long term relationships. When you need us, we're available. When we make a commitment, we keep it. And when questions arise, you'll speak with a real person who knows your account, not a call center or automated system. 
With Above N' Beyond Office Cleaning, you can focus on running your business while enjoying the peace of mind that comes from knowing your facility is being cared for by a team you can trust.
